summary: The clearest public exposure is not the consumer-facing learning app; it is the hidden plumbing around workforce education: healthcare training, tuition/payment rails, university service providers, and employer-benefits administration. No true small-cap pure play stood out with high confidence in this pass, so the best candidates are mostly mid-caps with underappreciated second-order leverage.
